description.zh: 汉朝继承并完善了秦制，以三公（丞相、太尉、御史大夫）为核心，九卿分掌具体事务。外儒内法，以德治为表、法治为里，建立了延续四百余年的大一统帝国。自汉武帝（前141-前87年在位）独尊儒术、推行察举选才后，形成了士大夫阶层主导的治理体系。西汉前期则以黄老道家思想为主导，与民休息。
description.en: The Han Dynasty inherited and refined the Qin system, with Three Lords (Chancellor, Grand Commandant, Imperial Censor) at the core and Nine Ministers managing specific affairs. It practiced Confucianism outwardly and Legalism internally, building a unified empire lasting over 400 years. After Emperor Wu (r. 141-87 BC) established Confucian orthodoxy and the recommendation system, a scholar-official-led governance took shape. The early Western Han was guided by Huang-Lao Daoism, prioritizing laissez-faire recovery.
